Navratri Prasad Recipes for Devotees

During the Navratri festival, specific prasad recipes are being highlighted for devotees to offer to the goddesses. For the fifth day, dedicated to Mata Skandmata, a banana-based halwa is recommended as a favorite offering. For the sixth day, a special halwa made with a unique ingredient, not sugar, is suggested, which can be prepared in 15 minutes. Additionally, a jaggery and flour barfi is recommended as a sweet offering that can be ready in just 10 minutes.
